STEP 2. Check the front-ECU power supply circuit (battery 
circuit) at the front-ECU connector A-09X.
(1) Disconnect the front-ECU connector A-09X and measure at 
the relay box side.
(2) Measure the voltage between terminal 16 and ground.
Q: Is the voltage approximately 12 volts (battery positive 
voltage)?
YES : Replace the front-ECU. Confirm the DTC 13 is not 
displayed.
NO : Go to Step 3.
STEP 3. Check the front-ECU connector A-09X for damage.
Q: Is front-ECU connector A-09X in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 4.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2. Confirm the DTC 13 is 
not displayed.
STEP 4. Check the harness wire between front-ECU 
connector A-09X and battery.
Q: Is the harness wire between front-ECU connector A-09X 
and battery in good condition?
YES : There is no action to be taken.
NO : Repair it. Confirm the DTC 13 is not displayed.
